zh-CN.headlineFact: 难民公约75年、AI新规落地、全球韧性再校准
zh-CN.headlineView: 今天的共同命题，是让保护、创新与恢复都能真正执行
zh-CN.headlineFull: 难民公约75年、AI新规落地、全球韧性再校准；今天的共同命题，是让保护、创新与恢复都能真正执行
zh-CN.intro: 1951年《难民地位公约》迎来75周年；欧盟AI Omnibus正式生效，为中小企业延长期限并扩展监管沙盒；世界肝炎日强调把检测、治疗与社区服务接成一体。巴基斯坦季风灾害、美国与伊朗暂停攻击、亚马孙剧院入遗，提醒世界同时处理人道、规则、气候与文化韧性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的进步，不是多一条宣言，而是多一套能落地的保护机制。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 未来越亮，越要把每个人都照进去。

en-US.headlineFact: Refugee protection turns 75, new AI rules take effect and global resilience is recalibrated
en-US.headlineView: today's shared task is to make protection, innovation and recovery executable
en-US.headlineFull: Refugee protection turns 75, new AI rules take effect and global resilience is recalibrated; today's shared task is to make protection, innovation and recovery executable
en-US.intro: The 1951 Refugee Convention marks 75 years; the EU AI Omnibus enters into force with longer timelines and wider regulatory sandboxes; World Hepatitis Day calls for connected testing, treatment and community services. Monsoon losses in Pakistan, the U.S.-Iran pause and Amazonian theaters joining UNESCO's list show the need for humanitarian, regulatory, climate and cultural resilience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Progress is not another declaration, but another protection mechanism that works.
en-US.doudouQuote: The brighter the future, the more people it must include.

zh-CN.headlineView: 国际保护框架面对创纪录流离失所压力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 《难民地位公约》迎来75周年；国际保护框架面对创纪录流离失所压力
zh-CN.intro: 联合国难民署指出，1951年公约在7月28日迎来75周年，仍是国际难民保护的基石；全球约有4160万难民，而该机构截至6月底仅获得全年所需资金的31%。纪念不只回望历史，更要求强化庇护、合作与接收社区支持。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 边境可以管理，但寻求安全的权利不能被预算缺口抹掉。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一份75岁的承诺，要靠今天的人继续兑现。

en-US.headlineFact: The Refugee Convention marks its 75th anniversary
en-US.headlineView: the global protection framework faces record displacement pressure
en-US.headlineFull: The Refugee Convention marks its 75th anniversary; the global protection framework faces record displacement pressure
en-US.intro: UNHCR says the 1951 Convention remains the foundation of international refugee protection on its 75th anniversary. About 41.6 million refugees remain displaced while the agency was only 31% funded at the end of June. The milestone calls for stronger asylum systems, cooperation and support for host communities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Borders can be managed, but the right to seek safety cannot be erased by a funding gap.
en-US.doudouQuote: A 75-year-old promise still needs people to keep it today.

sources.title: United Nations 2026 Calendar: 75th Anniversary of the 1951 Refugee Convention

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟 AI Omnibus 正式生效
zh-CN.headlineView: 监管简化与安全护栏同步推进
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟 AI Omnibus 正式生效；监管简化与安全护栏同步推进
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟委员会宣布 AI Omnibus 于7月27日生效，为中小企业和小型中等市值公司提供更相称的合规安排，延长部分时间表，扩大国家与欧盟级监管沙盒，并在保留安全与基本权利保障的前提下增加法律清晰度。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 好的AI监管，不是只会踩刹车，而是把试验场、路标和护栏一起建好。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 规则看得懂，创新才跑得稳。

en-US.headlineFact: The EU AI Omnibus enters into force
en-US.headlineView: regulatory simplification advances with safety guardrails
en-US.headlineFull: The EU AI Omnibus enters into force; regulatory simplification advances with safety guardrails
en-US.intro: The European Commission says the AI Omnibus took effect on July 27. It offers more proportionate compliance for SMEs and small mid-caps, extends selected timelines, expands national and EU-level regulatory sandboxes, and adds legal clarity while retaining safeguards for safety and fundamental rights.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Good AI regulation builds the test track, road signs and guardrails together.
en-US.doudouQuote: When rules are clear, innovation can run steadily.

zh-CN.headlineFact: SCORE推出“一人六位数企业”公开课
zh-CN.headlineView: 自由职业、AI与自动化组成单兵增长栈
zh-CN.headlineFull: SCORE推出“一人六位数企业”公开课；自由职业、AI与自动化组成单兵增长栈
zh-CN.intro: 美国小企业辅导机构SCORE将于7月30日举办免费线上课程，内容覆盖无雇员运营、多收入来源、自由职业协作、AI、自动化与精简技术栈。一人公司正从个人天赋叙事，转向可学习、可复制的系统化运营。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司不是一个人做完全部，而是把注意力交给正确的系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 老板可以只有一个，接口不能只有一个。

en-US.headlineFact: SCORE offers a One Person Empire course
en-US.headlineView: freelancers, AI and automation form a solo growth stack
en-US.headlineFull: SCORE offers a One Person Empire course; freelancers, AI and automation form a solo growth stack
en-US.intro: SCORE Idaho will host a free July 30 online course on operating without employees, multiple income streams, freelance collaboration, AI, automation and a lean technology stack. Solo entrepreneurship is shifting from a talent story to a repeatable operating system.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A one-person company is not one person doing everything; it assigns attention to the right systems.
en-US.doudouQuote: One founder is fine, but one interface is not.

sources.title: One Person Empire: How to Build a Six-Figure Business in 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界肝炎日聚焦“打破壁垒”
zh-CN.headlineView: 检测、治疗与社区服务需要被接成一条路
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界肝炎日聚焦“打破壁垒”；检测、治疗与社区服务需要被接成一条路
zh-CN.intro: 7月28日是世界肝炎日。世界卫生组织在前夕强调，终结艾滋病、病毒性肝炎与性传播感染，需要整合服务、持续创新和社区领导，并通过高级别纪念活动推动更可及的预防、检测和治疗。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共卫生的难点常常不是没有工具，而是工具没能抵达需要的人。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 少一道门槛，就多一个人及时被看见。

en-US.headlineFact: World Hepatitis Day focuses on breaking barriers
en-US.headlineView: testing, treatment and community services must connect
en-US.headlineFull: World Hepatitis Day focuses on breaking barriers; testing, treatment and community services must connect
en-US.intro: July 28 is World Hepatitis Day. WHO says ending HIV, viral hepatitis and sexually transmitted infections requires integrated services, innovation and community leadership, with prevention, testing and treatment made easier to reach.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Public health often lacks not tools, but a path that gets the tools to people.
en-US.doudouQuote: Remove one barrier and one more person can be seen in time.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 巴基斯坦季风灾害死亡人数破百
zh-CN.headlineView: 更强降雨预报考验预警与基层恢复
zh-CN.headlineFull: 巴基斯坦季风灾害死亡人数破百；更强降雨预报考验预警与基层恢复
zh-CN.intro: 美联社报道，巴基斯坦过去一个月季风雨与山洪造成的死亡人数已超过100人，气象部门警告本周仍可能出现强降雨。灾害应对从即时救援延伸到道路、住房、公共卫生和社区恢复。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 极端天气不会等工程完工，预警必须先跑到风险前面。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 雨还没停，恢复计划就要先开始。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与灾害。

en-US.headlineView: more heavy rain tests early warning and local recovery
en-US.headlineFull: Pakistan's monsoon death toll passes 100; more heavy rain tests early warning and local recovery
en-US.intro: AP reports that monsoon rains and flash floods have killed more than 100 people in Pakistan over the past month, while forecasters warn of more heavy rain this week. Response now extends from rescue to roads, housing, public health and community recovery.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Extreme weather will not wait for construction; warnings must reach risk first.
en-US.doudouQuote: Recovery planning must begin before the rain stops.

sources.title: Pakistan monsoon death toll tops 100 in a month as more heavy rain forecast

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国与伊朗连续两夜暂停攻击
zh-CN.headlineView: 短暂停火为谈判与航运安全争取窗口
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国与伊朗连续两夜暂停攻击；短暂停火为谈判与航运安全争取窗口
zh-CN.intro: 在连续升级后，美国与伊朗均暂停攻击，美方称此举为谈判留出空间。地区调停继续推进，但霍尔木兹海峡商业航运仍处低位，核问题与安全通航安排尚未解决。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 暂停不是和平，却是把节奏重新交还外交的必要间隙。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把按钮放下，才听得见桌对面。

en-US.headlineFact: The U.S. and Iran pause attacks for two nights
en-US.headlineView: a brief halt opens space for talks and safer shipping
en-US.headlineFull: The U.S. and Iran pause attacks for two nights; a brief halt opens space for talks and safer shipping
en-US.intro: After escalation, both the United States and Iran paused attacks as mediators pursued talks. Commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains depressed, while nuclear issues and safe-passage arrangements are unresolved.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A pause is not peace, but it is the interval needed to hand the rhythm back to diplomacy.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put down the button first; then you can hear the other side.

sources.title: US pauses attacks on Iran for a second day as peace talks continue

zh-CN.headlineFact: 巴西亚马孙两座剧院入选世界遗产
zh-CN.headlineView: 橡胶繁荣时代的建筑进入长期保护
zh-CN.headlineFull: 巴西亚马孙两座剧院入选世界遗产；橡胶繁荣时代的建筑进入长期保护
zh-CN.intro: 联合国教科文组织将贝伦的和平剧院与马瑙斯的亚马孙剧院联合列入世界遗产名录。两座19世纪末建筑融合欧洲影响、本地材料与亚马孙符号，记录了橡胶繁荣时期城市现代化的雄心。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 遗产不是过去的舞台布景，而是今天理解城市如何形成的证据。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 老剧院继续开灯，历史才不会散场。

en-US.headlineFact: Two Brazilian Amazon theaters join the World Heritage List
en-US.headlineView: architecture from the rubber-boom era enters long-term protection
en-US.headlineFull: Two Brazilian Amazon theaters join the World Heritage List; architecture from the rubber-boom era enters long-term protection
en-US.intro: UNESCO added Belem's Theatro da Paz and Manaus's Teatro Amazonas to the World Heritage List as a joint property. The late-19th-century theaters combine European influences, local materials and Amazonian symbols, recording the urban ambitions of the rubber-boom era.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Heritage is not old scenery; it is evidence of how today's cities were formed.
en-US.doudouQuote: Keep the old theaters lit so history does not leave the stage.

sources.title: UNESCO adds Brazil's Amazonia theaters to the World Heritage List

zh-CN.headlineFact: 六处遗产被列入“濒危名录”
zh-CN.headlineView: 冲突与气候威胁推动紧急保护
zh-CN.headlineFull: 六处遗产被列入“濒危名录”；冲突与气候威胁推动紧急保护
zh-CN.intro: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产委员会宣布六处遗产进入《濒危世界遗产名录》，其中三处以紧急程序列入。冲突、破坏与气候风险正迫使文化保护从长期修复转向更快的预防、监测与国际协作。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 文化遗产的安全不能等战争结束后再补课。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先保住现场，未来才有故事可讲。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：文化与安全。

en-US.headlineFact: Six heritage sites join the List in Danger
en-US.headlineView: conflict and climate threats accelerate emergency protection
en-US.headlineFull: Six heritage sites join the List in Danger; conflict and climate threats accelerate emergency protection
en-US.intro: UNESCO's World Heritage Committee added six properties to the List of World Heritage in Danger, three through emergency procedures. Conflict, damage and climate risk are pushing cultural protection toward faster prevention, monitoring and international cooperation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Heritage safety cannot wait until a war is over.
en-US.doudouQuote: Save the site first, so the future still has a story.

sources.title: Facing major threats, six new sites join UNESCO's List of World Heritage in Danger
